title: Electricity: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: Electric storage and draw use internal charge units; Generator Output is internal charge per simulated second. Battery Charge reads a 0 to 1 fraction and electric port inspection shows the EMP-adjusted supply fraction, both without a unit. A conversion of internal charge to joules or watts was not recovered.

Which code fills the queued EMP pulses was not traced, and the shark and kraken reading of object kinds 0 and 4 rests on the ANIMAL_TYPE text, not on a constructor that writes the kind, so it is not confirmed. EMP warheads, ordinary explosions and addon Lua are not yet tied to a pulse source, and the lightning reading of the 800-count weather pulse is an inference.

Component updates run 60 times per simulated second, so 60 × the charge per update is the charge per simulated second, in internal units. Generator Output already includes that factor. The shaft solver weights speed changes by force_emitter_max_force and has no torque or inertia in SI units, so it gives no charge-per-joule figure for mechanical work. The shipped realtime file sets electric_consumption_scale to 0.01, but the executable contains that name neither as ASCII nor as UTF-16LE text, and its effect was not recovered.

title: Engines: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: The classic update 0x14034ba00 was decoded by static analysis of one build; the game was not run. A conversion of the shaft weight and speed steps to SI torque in N m, watts or joules was not recovered.

Non-finite speeds are decoded only for the speed branch: it does not sanitize NaN or infinity. The complete non-finite fluid and network behaviour was not traced. Thermal efficiency in physical units is unknown.

title: Fluids: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: Native coverage for this build: ordinary and enclosed pipe networks, fixed liquid and gas tanks, the electric, impeller, modular and manual pumps, both filters, the old Hose and mechanical winches, rope-hook hoses, hose pulleys and the fluid connector. Custom-compartment volume from wall geometry and hull flooding were not decoded. Which editor, mission, career or creative and save-loading workflows enable the diesel and jet-fuel fill or keep restored contents, the fluid operation of a character-held hose end, slurry processing and steam or seawater behaviour outside the selected phase-change callers were not traced. The four realtime fluid damping names do not occur in the executable, so their effect on this build was not recovered.

The shipped realtime file lists gas and liquid base damping 0.99 and 0.9999, but none of the four fluid damping names occurs in the executable, so no setting binding was recovered. To test for an effect, compare two values of a setting on the same layout and starting inventory. Check Flow Rate against the solver bounds on the actual network graph: pipe length adds no volume, and hoses and connectors link networks at factor 1 or 0.5. Check a prefab gas tank's start (59.4 atm decoded) separately from a fluid-spawner compartment (60 atm in its tooltip).

title: Heat exchange: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: The exchanged quantity is a native amount × temperature unit; no conversion to joules or watts was recovered. No installation-independent effectiveness curve exists in the code: outlet temperatures depend on actual flow, fill, gas pressure, ambient and the connected networks.
Fuel rods are one decoded local heat source. The other sources that feed the surrounding-temperature sample, and their strengths, were not traced.

title: Jet engines: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: Static decompilation of one build; the game was not run. How merged and attached assemblies supply the body map that the neighbour search reads was not traced, so the equilibrium pressure, RPS and thrust of an assembled engine and its startup time are not predicted from a parts list.
Physical units of jet pressure and temperature were not established; pressure, temperature, charge and force stay in internal units.
SI torque, power and efficiency were not recovered. The partner part that switches the intake pressure rule off and the sources behind the intake's source sample were not traced.

title: Logic: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: Power Add and Power Meter select a case that computes nothing in the logic update. Their transmission-network formulas were not recovered, and whether the two definitions are obsolete in this build was not traced.

A Train Junction Controller's writes replace the junction's route bit, so the last write wins, but the order in which controllers on different vehicles update was not traced: a stable priority between controllers has not been established. Which bit value means the left or right branch for each track orientation was not established either.

title: Mechanical joints: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: Hinge impulse and slider force are internal game units; their conversion to SI torque or force was not recovered.
An equivalent spring rate and damping for the suspensions was not recovered; the update is a speed motor with a position-dependent force cap.

Ordinary joint fluid passage uses the shared bidirectional, all-species two-port solver with zero bias and factor 1, and delivered flow depends on network pressure and allocation history. Mechanical shaft speed, torque and any joint-specific losses across a joint were not traced.
The local sign flip of σ is decoded, but its world-axis direction for each placement and reflected orientation was not traced; that needs the joint-frame and body-order transforms.

The plain and power pivot definitions skip the hinge setup's explicit angle-limit branch, so their tooltip quarter-turn stop does not come from that setter. Their assembled travel and any other stop mechanism remain unverified.

title: Modular engines: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: SI torque, power and energy were not recovered: the inertia weights, RPS impulses, heat in amount × °C and electrical charge have no established conversion to N m, watts or joules.

Modular registration and connection grouping are decoded, but the editor's complete placement and alignment validator was not traced. Which attachment positions and orientations the editor accepts is open beyond the coupling names the crank and manifold walks follow.

Beyond overheat, restore and the capped setter, shared spatial damage and repair routines call component damage setters, and repair subtracts a caller-supplied amount and clamps at 0. Collision attribution, damage thresholds, tool cadence and complete repair rates were not traced.

title: Other components: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: Not decoded: how the body-mass producer's redistribution, clamping and linked bodies, and fuel, cargo or damage, change the signature S, and how S compares with the editor's mass total; which collision bits terrain, water, glass and vehicles register with, and so which of them block the line-of-sight query; the height sampler 0x1402bc7d0 behind the legacy height gates; what else can set a legacy sensor's saved radar_fov; what the legacy Signal Strength output carries; the laser missile radar (radar_type 2) acquisition path; advanced sonar submersion gating and the noisemaker's effect on the sonar. For radios: how the legacy radios' separate send and receive frequencies and their data use the receive routine, whose legacy records carry one frequency and no payload flags; payload and audio effects of a weak signal beyond the clamp(2 × S) level; the exact rounding of the native power routine in the height term. None of the radio figures was checked in a running game.

title: Propulsion: decode remaining behavior and formulas

title: Steam: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: Ignition writes 3600 to a state that the recovered firebox combustion paths test as a nonzero enable. No countdown was found in those paths, and the complete gameplay writer that clears or decrements it was not traced. Hot damaged fireboxes can queue a component and body event when vehicle damage is on. The event consumer, any global blast and any pressure-triggered boiler rupture were not traced; no pressure limit or burst test appears in the boiler, condenser or phase code. Also not decoded: the unit steam_component_capacity once had, and any joule, N m or efficiency calibration of coal heat, turbine speed and piston drive.

title: Transmission: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: SI torque, inertia and physical power losses are unknown: the bridge is a weighted speed exchange in solver units, and no conversion to newton-metres or watts was recovered. No finite slip torque or friction law was recovered.

torque_gearbox_2's tooltip claims a torque-difference limit of 4000, but its enforcing path and internal unit were not established. The recovered gearbox update, ratio helper and shaft solver hold no 4000 and compare the copied force_emitter_max_force with nothing.

Damage disables the gearbox or clutch bridge. Both use the shared capped damage setter, and the shared repair routine can subtract damage to 0. The complete damage triggers, repair cadence and any torque-triggered breakage were not traced.

The rebuild clears registered shaft-node group pointers before freeing the old groups, then forms new groups and appends members in connection-discovery order. Which connector changes schedule a rebuild, and the update ordering that would rule out a pass on stale membership, were not traced, so the braking outcome of a contradicting loop after a rebuild is not predicted.

title: Weapons: decode remaining behavior and formulas

No direct write to the recoil multiplier besides its initial 1 was found, so the reduction a muzzle brake's tooltip promises is not established. No figure here was measured in a running game.

title: Electric Fluid Pump: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: Compare Flow Rate in game with the bounds above and with the finite-flow estimate for the same loop.

Native code gives the pump's bias, its equal-pressure flow bounds of 200 L/s (small) and 400 L/s (large) and its electricity request of 0.001 × Max Power per update; they are in the practical behaviour research. A pipe run is one 40 L network whatever its length, so pipe length adds neither volume nor resistance; actual flow depends on fill, backpressure and other ports on the same network. No conversion of pump_pressure to an SI pressure or of the electricity unit to watts was recovered.

water_pump: attributes.pump_pressure. Pump bias factor. The port solver adds the electric pump's supply × this × Max Power, or the impeller's 4 × |RPS| × this, to the pressure difference across the pump, on the solver's pressure scale, which the tank pressure outputs report in atmospheres; the flow bounds are in the practical behaviour research. It is not a delivered head. No conversion of pump_pressure to an SI pressure was recovered.

title: Impeller Pump: decode remaining behavior and formulas

locations.text: Static analysis of one build; the flow figures are equal-pressure bounds, not measured flow. The shaft load unit was not established.

The impeller reads the speed of the shaft on its RPS port and pushes with bias 4 × |RPS| × pump_pressure. Spinning the shaft backward pushes the same way. Unlike the electric pumps it is two-way: backpressure can push fluid back through it, and at low flow it exchanges temperature between its two networks. The shaft port records a load request of 0.1 × pump_pressure; its torque unit was not established.

Shaft speed is in RPS. The pump bias, shaft load request and flow bounds come from native code and are in the practical behaviour research. No conversion of shaft weight, force or charge to N m, watts or joules was recovered.

It is not a delivered head. No conversion of pump_pressure to an SI pressure was recovered.

title: Composite data over electrical cables: resolve missing mechanics

Repeated port labels are preserved; the piston's first and second Steam In and Steam Out are matched to its chambers by definition order (inference).

title: Gear ratios and clutch engagement: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: The ratio, coupling and clutch laws come from that native decode, not from these definitions alone. Not recovered: SI torque and physical power losses, a finite slip torque or friction law, the path and internal unit that would enforce torque_gearbox_2's 4000 limit, and the complete damage triggers, repair cadence and any torque-triggered breakage. Which connector changes schedule a shaft rebuild, and the update ordering that would rule out stale membership, were not traced.

title: Weapon loading, ammunition and timed fuses: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: The velocity, flight, spread, impact, loading and fuse figures come from that native decode, not from these definitions alone. Still not decoded: a throughput model for arbitrary belt networks, the fastest firing schedule for cannons whose breech is opened and loaded by external control, and what follows the decoded impact magnitude and armour-piercing speed loss: the target voxel damage, the armour-angle response and blast shielding. The recoil multiplier starts at 1 and no write that applies a muzzle brake was found, so the reduction its tooltip promises is not established. The firing rates above are state-machine inferences, not measurements.

title: Wheels, grip and suspension: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: The units, slip limit, grip, shaft and spring figures come from that native decode. Still not recovered: the impulse helpers' scale B, so grip has no newton figure and no curve against normal load; what sets the physics mode byte that gates the springs, and the other contact cases; track grouping and Track Tension; and the legacy wheels' speed law. No speed or slip was measured in a running game.

title: Winch controls, length and hose connections: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: The reel rates, length limits, charge requests, simultaneous controls and hose exchange come from that native decode. Rates are changes of the rope's rest length; travel of a loaded hook was not measured. Still not recovered: a force-equivalent rope stiffness. The rope is a Bullet soft-body chain whose material coefficients are 1 without a conversion to N/m. The decoded reel and rope paths have no maximum tension, maximum solver impulse or tensile snapping threshold: rope-node ropes get an uncapped corrective impulse min(K_A, K_B) × (D - L) when stretched beyond their length, neither reel routine compares a force with a break threshold, and the explicit rope removal is called from requests, endpoint cleanup and endpoint control state, not from a force or strain test. Whether the Bullet link solver or collision and damage code caps the load or severs a rope was not traced.

title: Gravity, damping and friction: resolve missing mechanics

locations.text: The world, solver, timestep, damping and friction figures come from those native decodes. Still not recovered: the solver's normal and tangent impulse iterations, its friction-row bounds, collision-shape coverage and restitution threshold, and the rule by which mass redistribution rewrites a vehicle's gravity.
